concept

population

______ is the extent to which a test appears to measure what it is intended to measure.
Face Validity

______ is an inert therapy that looks like the drug that is being tested.
placebo
A placebo is an inert therapy that looks like the drug that is being tested.
______ is a topic that you are interested in.
good topic
A good topic is a topic that you are interested in.
______ are considered as the gold standard as far as etiological investigations are concerned.
Intervention studies

______ is a prospective experimental design to compare one or more interventions against a control group in order to determine the effectiveness of the interventions.
Randomized controlled clinical trial
Randomized controlled clinical trial is a prospective experimental design to compare one or more interventions against a control group in order to determine the effectiveness of the interventions.
______ is an entity that can assume different values with different observations and can be measured or categorized.
variable
